narration: One night, a tiny rock crab named Pebble spotted something sparkling on the beach!
It was a real star — and it had fallen right out of the sky! Pebble looked up and saw a dark empty spot where the star used to be.
Pebble picked up the star and started climbing — up the big sand dune, over the wobbly rocks, and all the way to the top of the lighthouse!
At the very top, Pebble held the star as high as his tiny claws could reach... and WHOOOOSH — it zipped right back up into the sky!
The star popped right back into its spot! The sky was complete again — and every other star twinkled extra bright to say thank you!
Pebble the rock crab — the smallest hero on the whole beach! Come back tomorrow to find out what Pebble discovers buried under the big coral reef!
